cr.title: Cutting
cr.intro: How this site's cutting table checks hides and keeps their leftovers. A change applies from now on: hides already reserved, issued, cut or tagged keep what they were.
cr.introDefault: This site has no floor rules yet: it runs on the defaults below (one shade lot per order, the photo optional, 10 dm² the smallest remnant). Apply a change to give it its own.
cr.reasonHint: Optional: a few words for whoever reads the history later.
cr.fromNow: The new shade rule applies to reservations, picks and cuts from now on; reservations already made stay as they are.
cr.default: The defaults every site starts with.
cr.viewOnly: Only the production manager or the Owner changes this.
cr.done: Saved: the cutting rules apply from now on.
cr.unchanged: Nothing to change: the rules were already so.

ORDER.title: One shade lot per order
ORDER.body: Every hide of a work order or order line comes from one shade lot: the reserve and the pick refuse another (an office override with a reason lets one through), the cutting table warns.

GARMENT.title: One shade lot per garment
GARMENT.body: An order may use several shade lots; the cutting table warns when a part would complete a garment from another shade lot than its other parts.

OFF.title: No shade check
OFF.body: No shade lot is checked at the reserve, the pick or the cutting table.

photo.title: Photo of the hide before cutting
photo.toggle: Ask a photo of the hide before cutting
photo.on: Asked before the first cut of each hide
photo.onHint: The cutter takes a photo of the hide on the table before its first cut; without it the cut is held, in words.
photo.offHint: The cutter may take a photo of the hide on the table; nothing waits for it.

remnant.title: Smallest remnant kept
remnant.hint: A leftover smaller than this is waste, not a remnant ({other}). At most 10 m².
remnant.hintNone: A leftover smaller than this is waste, not a remnant. At most 10 m².

held.area: Give the smallest remnant as an area above 0, with up to four decimals.
held.tooLarge: The smallest remnant is at most 10 m² (a whole hide is 4–6 m²).
held.reasonLong: The reason is at most 500 characters.

read.photoOn: A photo of the hide is asked before its first cut.
read.photoOff: A photo of the hide before cutting is optional.
read.remnant: A leftover smaller than {area} is waste, not a remnant.

problem.read: These rules could not be read. Try again.
problem.write: The change was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed the floor rules of this site meanwhile: reload them, then apply again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not change this.
problem.gone: This site or company is no longer there.
problem.invalid: The change is not valid: check the values.
problem.offline: No connection: nothing was saved. Try again when you are back online.

tolerance.title: Leather area tolerance
tolerance.intro: How far a leather lot's measured area may differ from the tannery's before the area check opens a claim, when its purchase order line names none. The order line's own tolerance always wins.

now.COMPANY: Now: {percent} % either way, this company's own.
now.TENANT: Now: {percent} % either way, the value of every company.
now.DEFAULT: Now: {percent} % either way, the default (no company sets one).

tolerance.own: This company keeps its own tolerance
tolerance.ownHint: From 0 to 100 percent, up to two decimals: the incoming area check and the re-measure read it from now on.
tolerance.fromTenant: Off: the company follows every company's {percent} %.
tolerance.fromDefault: Off: the company follows the default, 2 %.
tolerance.viewOnly: Only a person who manages purchasing changes this.
tolerance.held: Give the tolerance as a percent from 0 to 100, with up to two decimals.
tolerance.done: Saved: the leather area tolerance applies from now on.
